description: This PHP source file defines a class `Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_TeraWurfl` that implements a features adapter using the Tera Wurfl API to retrieve device capabilities based on HTTP request data within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for loading the Wurfl class, fetching device capabilities, and building a comprehensive capabilities array.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_TeraWurfl
classes.description: A features adapter class that interfaces with the Tera Wurfl API to determine device features based on request headers.

methods.name: getFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves device features from an HTTP request array, utilizing Tera Wurfl API, loading dependencies dynamically, and throwing exceptions if configurations are missing.

methods.name: getAllCapabilities
methods.description: Builds and returns an array of all device capabilities by extracting information from the TeraWurfl object.
